\begin{tabular}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.25\linewidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.72\linewidth}@{}}
\toprule
Component & Setting \\
\midrule
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textit{Models}} \\
Base model & Qwen3.5-9B (non-thinking; \texttt{enable\_thinking=False} everywhere) \\
Advisors & base model + role prompts (Extractor, Reasoner, Verifier), served with vLLM, outputs cached \\
Manager & LoRA on Qwen3.5-9B; S$_1$ = the paper's one-round SFT manager \\
\addlinespace
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textit{Rounds and data collection}} \\
Rounds & 3 (each: collect, SFT, FA-GRPO); rounds 4--5 for the no-GRPO v3 chain (MedQA, MMLU-Pro, AQuA) \\
Questions collected per round & 400 (GPQA reuses its 200 round-1 roots) \\
Max depth & 2 \\
Commit:rescue balancing $\rho$ & MedQA 3.0, MMLU-Pro 2.0, GPQA 2.0, AQuA-RAT 1.0 \\
\addlinespace
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textit{SFT (each round)}} \\
Epochs & 3 \\
Learning rate & $1\times10^{-5}$ \\
Batch & 1 per device $\times$ 8 gradient-accumulation steps (effective 8) \\
Max sequence length & 4,096 tokens (GPQA 16,384) \\
Seed / context / draft supervision & 42 / paper (tool schemas rendered as in the S$_1$ prompt) / none (route-only loss) \\
\addlinespace
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textit{FA-GRPO (each round)}} \\
Steps & 64 steps $\times$ 4 questions per step (256 questions per round; GPQA pool 146) \\
Learning rate / max grad norm / seed & $5\times10^{-6}$ / 1.0 / 0 \\
$\beta$ (root / dec / rev) & 0.1 / 0.1 / 0.02 \\
Anchor $\lambda$ & 0.03 (4 anchor rows per step); estimator: exact \\
Guard & every 8 steps on a 64-question probe: call-rate delta $\leq$ 0.10 and KL$_{\mathrm{dec}}$ $\leq$ 0.05, otherwise roll back to the last good step \\
Informative fraction & $\geq$ 0.15 of revision states with $J \in (0.02, 0.98)$ \\
\addlinespace
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textit{Acceptance and gates}} \\
GRPO acceptance & dev acc $\geq$ S$_k$ $-$ 1 pt; calls $\leq$ S$_k$ + 0.15; call gap $\geq$ 0.5 $\times$ S$_k$ gap; $\geq$ 15\% informative revision states ($J \in (0.02, 0.98)$); else G$_k$ $:=$ S$_k$ \\
Gates & accuracy tolerance 0.01; extra calls 0.15; gap fraction 0.5; SFT max calls 1.5; SFT max accuracy drop 0.03 \\
\addlinespace
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textit{Pools}} \\
Development & MedQA 200, MMLU-Pro 200, GPQA 100, AQuA-RAT 254 \\
Locked test & MedQA 500, MMLU-Pro 500 (pool test), GPQA 100, AQuA-RAT 254 \\
\addlinespace
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textit{Arms}} \\
dynamic & re-collect with G$_{k-1}$ each round, marginal-value labels, SFT from G$_{k-1}$, then FA-GRPO \\
static & reuse S$_1$'s labels every round, SFT from G$_{k-1}$, then FA-GRPO \\
success & like dynamic but any trajectory ending in a correct answer is a demonstration (shortest path not required) \\
\addlinespace
\multicolumn{2}{@{}l}{\textit{Versions}} \\
v1 & paper SFT target (draft letter supervised) + GRPO \\
v3 & draft letter never supervised (route-only loss), no GRPO \\
v3+GRPO (main) & v3 loss + FA-GRPO each round \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
